item.title: [ 5 Maps ] Heaven Can Wait 2
item.description:
View Article
Media
Media gallery
1 / 8
After surviving an air crash, the survivors turn out to be in most epicenter of the contamination. The Military has already left all attempts to rescue survivors in the region. Thanks to Gajofra for creating loading screen art and Marcos Outsider from "Project Detonado" Youtube channel for gamemaps thumbnail. Just to clarify: I did this conversion with Rombikon (Romka) and AGRESSOR authorization, Rombikon sent the L4D1 source to me by email, and I worked on it. First version was based on original campaign, after I modded it with versus changes but keeping native AI director difficulty. I mean the true Rombikon, not that account registered in this site claiming to be HCW author. The real Rombikon said to me his account was given to a guy of project, probably Rustem666666 (Rustemka), then both account are the same people. I'm not responsible by HCW Hard version. I sent source code to Rustemka in the past but rather he created a new hard version, instead to improve the old one.

item.title: [ 5 Maps ] Anemoia - (backrooms)
item.description:
View Article
Media
Media gallery
1 / 8
[h1] Anemoia [/h1] I fell in love with that word, nostalgia for something never lived... In the shadow of yesterday, the soul plunges, Sighs for moments that never were, Longing for a time that is lost, Yearnings for a past that never met. To create this campaign, I was inspired by liminal spaces and, obviously, the backrooms. I tried to recreate photos and memories from my childhood that make me feel kenopsia. At the beginning of this project, the only thing I dreamed about while sleeping was these places every day. I grew fond of them and became obsessed with them, each campaign I made while listening to old music from the 1930s and/or dreamcore music, etc. It has a small hidden lore, which if you like it, will intensify in a second part. [h2] Where are we? [/h2] The survivors... What happened? Did those soldiers rescue us? Why is this place filled with dead people? They should be empty and someone isn't happy about it. Memory is filling up, these places are getting out of control, luckily there are weapons and a cure... Testers : Zatanna Farazar Roku Best quotes from Walter White (Thomas) El Comandante (Juan) Fero Brenda Kaiman [h2] Versus [/h2] In this campaign, you can play in Versus mode, the only problem is that this mode was not tested and also I think that if you don't know the map well, it will be difficult to play, but it's there in case you want to try. [h2] Chapter features and instructions [/h2] Party : Mazes full of birthday party rooms, something lurks in the shadows... Be careful with those dark places, I wouldn't recommend being there. Instruction [spoiler]Find a gas can and fill it in the right place, then choose the right cake to open the exit[/spoiler] Poolrooms : Resources are scarce, attention is what counts... item.title: [ 5 Maps ] Lima Infection Legacy
item.description:
View Article
Media
Media gallery
1 / 8
Description Lima Infection is a custom campaign for Left 4 Dead 2 set in a post-apocalyptic version of Lima, Peru. Explore streets, parks, shopping centers, and iconic locations of the capital city while fighting through relentless infected hordes and discovering a story inspired by Peruvian culture. This is the Legacy version of Lima Infection, originally released in 2025. It is being uploaded separately from the Steam Workshop release for players who wish to preserve and play the original version of the campaign. Additional Contributors Roku — Level design. Cesar Mallqui — Writing and reference photography. Johan Yuffre — Marketing and visual design. Diir.lain — 3D art. Auralis — Music. Nothara — Music. Benjamin Guillen — Music. Leydi Butron — Voice acting. Franco Arrieta — Voice acting. Diego Paucar — Voice acting. Carlos Jara (Charlie Leng) — Voice acting. Follow Games — Testing and bug fixing. Chaos Kansei — Testing and bug fixing. Jean Carlos Luna — Testing and bug fixing. SrLobito — Testing and bug fixing. inflencr.pe — Special thanks. Diego Castañeda — Special thanks. Compatibility This campaign may conflict with other map or visual addons that modify the same resources. Disable conflicting addons before playing. item.description:
View Article
Media
Media gallery
1 / 6
Red Square (Campaign) is loosely based on my Zombie Master:Reborn map zmr_red_square which itself was a spiritual successor to zm_red_horror In an alternative Timeline the Survivors have learned about a Secret Weapon hidden beneath Red Square Fight your way through 5 maps: 1: The subway station that leads to Lenins Mausoleum on Red Square 2: The entrance to the secret underground facilities 3: The Workers Sector 4: The Secret Weapon research facility 5: The finale on Red Square Contains custom models, custom gatling gun replacement, custom map assets, a unique custom escape "vehicle" and a lot of COMMUNISM
